pkgmetadata.longdescription: copr is the Python client library for the Copr build service. It provides the copr.v3 Client together with proxies for projects, packages, builds, chroots and webhooks, so scripts and tools can drive a Copr instance through its APIv3.
copr 是 Copr 构建服务的 Python 客户端库，提供 copr.v3 的 Client 以及项目、 软件包、构建、chroot 和 webhook 等代理对象，脚本和工具可以通过 APIv3 操作 Copr 实例。
